The '''Empty Odonata Bottle''' is an {{Uncommon}} item in the [[Rift Dimension]].

== Obtaining ==
The '''Empty Odonata Bottle''' is unlocked in the {{NPCSprite|Argofay Bugshopper}}'s shop once the player has purchased a {{Item|Larva Hook}} from them.

Once unlocked, an '''Empty Odonata Bottle''' can be purchased for {{Item|Shy Crux|amount=2}} and {{Motes|400}} from the [[NPC]].

== Usage ==
An '''Empty Odonata Bottle''' can be used to obtain a {{Item|Bottled Odonata}} by holding the bottle and looking at an {{MobSprite|Odonata}} while within a {{Green|3}} block radius of it.

The player must continue looking at the {{MobSprite|Odonata}} for {{Green|3}} seconds to successfully catch it and transform the '''Empty Odonata Bottle''' into a {{Item|Bottled Odonata}}.
